📺 Superstore (2015–2021)

Superstore follows a hilarious group of employees working at Cloud 9, a fictional big-box retail store in St. Louis, Missouri, where everyday shifts turn into unpredictable adventures filled with workplace drama, awkward situations, and ridiculous customer encounters. At the center of the story are Amy, a hardworking employee trying to balance her career and personal life, and Jonah, an idealistic new worker whose opinions often clash with those around him. Alongside their eccentric coworkers Dina, Garrett, Cheyenne, Mateo, and Glenn, the team navigates complicated relationships, unusual store policies, demanding customers, and the challenges of working in retail. Starring America Ferrera and Ben Feldman, the series combines laugh-out-loud comedy, heartfelt moments, and relatable workplace experiences while exploring friendship, teamwork, romance, and the realities of everyday working life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Workplace Sitcom • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Justin Spitzer

📺 Seasons: 6

📺 Where to Watch: Peacock and Hulu in the United States. Availability may vary.
